items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-09
items.q: it's over in Algiers where Red Allen lived. You know where he came from.

ctx.x: You know what I mean? Uh-huh. Even when they played them blues. You see them sporting gals coming in, yeah, boy, you know, that's something. And the cat might stand up and sing the blues. And every word is being so much. I was never a top rock. I saw Joe Oliver break up a baseball game, which was out of sport, coming from the cemetery in a brass band, playing a long ways from Tipperary. Oh, man. When they went back, it's over in Algiers where Red Allen lived. You know where he came from. And, uh, it's about a…
I've been wondering if they still have these funeral marches as often as they used to work. Well, people still dying.
